propositions: ADR 0098 must document the approved RP-04 decision: Rebar composes immutable non-secret operation configuration separately from provider-auth/runtime bindings at application boundaries
The ADR must cite completed primary-source research on Pydantic, PydanticAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, boto3/AWS, Git credential helpers, SSH, Jira, CI secret injection, and subprocess environments

Op-cert startup composition requires exactly one key path/multiline value, validation before service work, process-owned file permissions (0700/0600), and context-local signer/principal/push policy without application runtime SSM/boto3 coupling

The ADR must clarify that static restart/redeploy rotation is distinct from SDK-native in-process refresh, and that provider-native pre-client auth/session injection remains separately owned at upstream lifecycles
ADR 0098 amends ADR 0049 only at per-job retrieval/composition detail while preserving its protocol, trust roots/eras, producer, and deployment storage choices

The numbered Draft Critique must identify or clear uncited claims, internal inconsistencies, missing constraints, and conflicts with ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0049, 0050, 0059, and 0083 before maintainer authorization to merge
